description: This file contains inline functions for encoding and decoding E1AP (E-UTRAN New Radio Application Protocol) messages related to bearer context setup, modification, and release, specifically for 5G network signaling. It includes functions to fill ASN.1 structures from internal data representations and vice versa, focusing on QoS flows, DRB (Data Radio Bearer) setup, and security information.

methods.name: fill_asn1_qos_flow_info_item
methods.description: Encodes internal QoS flow parameters into ASN.1 structure for E1AP messages.

methods.name: fill_asn1_drb_to_setup_item
methods.description: Encodes internal DRB setup item into ASN.1 structure for E1AP messages.

methods.name: pdu_session_type_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal PDU session type enum to ASN.1 enumeration.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 structure for bearer context setup request from internal request data.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_response
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 bearer context setup response into internal data structure.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 structure for bearer context modification request from internal request data.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_response
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 bearer context modification response into internal data structure.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_release_command
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 structure for bearer context release command from internal command data.
